text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "En mars 2020, le Département fédéral de l'environnement, des transports, de l'énergie et de la communication (DETEC) a chargé l'OFCOM d'effectuer des tests sur les antennes adaptatives.", "gist": "DETEC commissioned OFCOM to test adaptive antennas in March 2020"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "OFCOM", "gist": "Swiss Federal Office of Communications"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "DETEC", "gist": "Swiss Federal Department of Environment, Transport, Energy and Communications"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "rapport \"Testkonzession und Messungen adaptive Antennen\"", "gist": "Report on adaptive antenna testing and measurements"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Le rapport \"Testkonzession und Messungen adaptive Antennen\" (disponible en allemand uniquement) rassemble les mesures et les simulations effectuées dans le cadre de ce mandat.", "gist": "The report in German compiles measurements and simulations from the mandate"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Téléphonie mobile : l’aide à l’exécution relative aux antennes adaptatives est publiée", "gist": "Mobile telephony: the implementation aid on adaptive antennas is published"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Contact spécialisé", "gist": "Specialist contact information"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "09.04.2025", "gist": "Last modified date: April 9, 2025"}]}
